_about: Candidate games/categories not yet backed by a verified free catalog source and/or a sourced factory size. update_catalog.py probes each weekly and flags it in NEW_SETS.md when a free source shows it. Promote to a real source only after a human checks that source's terms. Games given a registry profile in Nov 2026 remain listed here only when the catalog is still missing or the size is still unsourced.
